## Examples {.unnumbered}

This is a example of operation where we combine two text together


```{r}
paste("Hello", "world", sep = " ")

paste("Hello", "world", sep = " there ")

paste("Hello", "world", "life", sep = " there ")

word1 <- "Hello"
word2 <- "world"

paste(word1, word2)
```
